name: Supply Drop
description:
A Resistance cell intercepts a GENESIS supply convoy and shares the haul.

Example card: replace it with your own.

name: Distress Call
description:
A Resistance cell is pinned down and calling for help. The ODR can answer it as a Tactical Action before it leaves play.

Example card: replace it with your own.

system.discardText: No one came. The people remember.

name: Uprising
description:
The people rise against their overseers. The Resistance's name spreads, and GENESIS notices.

Example card: replace it with your own.

name: GENESIS Propaganda
description:
Broadcasts paint the Resistance as terrorists. Doc: GENESIS Propaganda lowers Reputation.

Example card: replace it with your own.

name: Reprisal
description:
GENESIS strikes back at a territory that defied it. Answer it as a Tactical Action, or pay when it leaves play.

Example card: replace it with your own.

system.discardText: If not stopped, one Engineering upgrade here is destroyed.

name: Crackdown
description:
GENESIS floods a territory with troops and checkpoints, when the GM chooses.

Example card: replace it with your own.

name: Ion Storm
description:
A storm of charged particles blinds sensors and radios across the region for a week. GENESIS patrols lose their eyes; so do the Resistance's listening posts.

Example card: replace it with your own.

name: Refugee Column
description:
Thousands flee a collapsing district. GENESIS diverts troops to control the roads, and the Resistance shares what it can.

Example card: replace it with your own.

system.discardText: The people remember who fed them.
